Title: Women's Hooded Teddy Coat with Button Closure
Body (HTML):
A hooded teddy coat with button closure and long silhouette for everyday layering.

This women's hooded teddy coat features a textured fleece finish, button-front closure, and a long straight-cut silhouette. The attached hood provides added coverage, while side pockets offer practical storage. The relaxed shape layers easily over casual outfits for daily wear, commuting, and seasonal styling.

Features of the Women's Teddy Coat for Everyday Wear

  • Textured Fleece: Soft fleece texture gives the coat a warm and tactile appearance.
  • Button-Front Closure: Structured button fastening ensures secure closure and a clean front line.
  • Attached Hood: Fixed hood adds coverage and a relaxed, casual silhouette.
  • Side Pockets: Practical pockets at each side hold small essentials like keys or a phone.
  • Long Silhouette: Extended length provides coverage from shoulders to mid-thigh for layering.
